title: Dell XPS 15 9570 laptop (4K touch, GTX 1050 Ti)
description:
Dell XPS 15 9570, bought new January 2019. Intel i7-8750H, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 4K touch display, GTX 1050 Ti. Includes original charger and USB-C dongle. Works flawlessly; minor scuffs on the lid.

title: Labgrey T1 2-in-1 folding treadmill
description:
Labgrey T1 2-in-1 folding treadmill. Handrail down design for under-desk use, or upright for walking/running. Quiet motor, speed up to 12 km/h. Used only a few times — perfect condition, all original packaging.

title: Scrapper hybrid bike (CR7, step-through frame)
description:
Scrapper hybrid/city bike with low-step "wave" frame. 7-speed gears, comfortable upright position, 28" wheels. Includes rear rack and lights. Some cosmetic scratches but mechanically sound — great for commuting.

title: Sony WH-1000XM3 noise-cancelling headphones
description:
Sony WH-1000XM3 over-ear noise-cancelling headphones. Industry-leading ANC, 30-hour battery, LDAC support. Includes carrying case, USB-C cable, and 3.5mm audio cable. Earpads show slight wear but work perfectly.

title: Atomic C-Series 5.2 skis (158 cm) + poles
description:
Atomic C-Series 5.2 skis, 158 cm length, with bindings (DIN 3–10). Includes matching poles. Good all-mountain skis for intermediate to advanced skiers. Some scratches on the base but no major damage — freshly waxed.

title: Nordica NFS ski boots — size EU 42
description:

title: BenQ GW2270 21.5" Full HD monitor
description:

description:
